Buttons are meant for more.

ThreeStars Apps is the home of KeyStar and PenStar, developed by Enrique Anthony Galea.

A hotkey for almost everything.

I'm passionate about automation and finding a hotkey for almost everything. I love making everyday actions quicker, whether that's on my phone or at my desktop.

On my phone, my hardware buttons do around 50 things, my single-page home screen does close to 100, and my navigation bar does another 40. On my desktop, I set up more than 100 keyboard hotkeys.

KeyStar and PenStar are my way of sharing that passion.
